title: Hanabishi Wall Fan Summer Wind SW16W |16 inch blade Low Noise Powerful Durable Electric Fan
description:
Hanabishi Wall Fan Summer Wind SW16W |16 inch blade Low Noise Powerful Durable Electric Fan
16 inch blade
Pastel colored blade
3 speed control system
Oscillation control
Thermal fuse protected motor
Available colors: Blue and Purple

Hanabishi is a recognized leading home appliances brand in the Philippines for more than thirty years now having started in 1986. Its decades of existence in the local market demonstrate its firm dedication to consistently carry on its mandate of providing the patrons what matter most to them – QUALITY and AFFORDABILITY.

1 year warranty on electric parts
5 years warranty on motor/compressor
Please keep the receipt/sales invoice that this included in the package. It will serve as a warranty for future claiming purposes. LIFETIME FREE SERVICE WARRANTY.
Just bring it to the nearest service center in your location.
Thank you for your interest in Hanabishi appliances!
